name: 防水纤长卷翘不晕染睫毛膏款

styleLock.backgroundSystem: flat seamless #FFFFFF studio field for the packshot, flat #E9EAF0 panel for every infographic screen, one low-key #1C1C1E surface band reserved for the closing screen; no gradients, no textures, no random scenery
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool neutral 5500-6000K studio light, soft front-left key with a bounce fill on the shadow side, one soft contact shadow grounding every object, controlled speculars only on the glossy cap and on wet pigment, no flare
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte #E9EAF0 panel card and matte #F2F1EE card, plus one low-key #1C1C1E surface for the closing screen; no marble, no wood, no fabric drape
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif; Chinese copy is always 「」-bracketed, headline 28-32pt, sub-label 16-20pt, label 13-14pt, no dense body text
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons, hairline leader lines, circular magnifier viewports, numbered circles in #6E6AA8 and one curved connector arc; no 3D icons, no illustration, no photography inside badges
styleLock.presentationRules: the product holds one stable slight 3/4 or clean 90-degree side angle with identical scale, height and label placement on every screen; eye-area imagery is always cropped to brow-and-lash-line only with no readable identity; hands are optional, relaxed and anatomically correct; skin keeps real pore texture and is never smoothed
noDrift: no invented numbers, durations, multipliers or test data
no identifiable face or full-eye beauty portrait
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent editorial cool-tone eye-makeup ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of studio field #FFFFFF, panel #E9EAF0, ink #1C1C1E and one accent #6E6AA8; cool neutral 5500-6000K studio light with a soft front-left key, bounce fill and one soft contact shadow grounding every object, no flare; one modern geometric sans-serif with Chinese copy always set as 「」-bracketed at headline 28-32pt, sub-label 16-20pt, label 13-14pt and no dense body text; thin single-weight line icons, hairline leader lines, circular magnifier viewports, numbered circles in #6E6AA8 and one curved connector arc as the only infographic components; flat backgrounds only, no gradients, no scenery; the product keeps one stable slight 3/4 or clean 90-degree side angle with identical scale and label placement, eye-area imagery cropped to brow-and-lash-line only, skin left with real pore texture; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented numbers.

provenance.notes: 由 9 屏详情页长图切片提炼为一套模版。L1 判定依据：源图主体是眼部着色彩妆（管身+齿梳纤维刷头的睫毛膏，卖点为纤长卷翘、浓密、防水不晕、温水即卸），taxonomy 中「眼妆」只挂在 L1「美妆彩妆」之下，故不按源文件夹名「美妆」归到护肤个护；L2 取眼妆，leaf 按实际品名写为防水纤长卷翘睫毛膏。已剥离内容：原品牌字样与管身/外盒包装印刷、模特可辨识面容与身份（全部改为眉-睫毛线局部裁切或手部、低机位眼周视角）、原文案与英文小标题、圆形放大镜区原描述词、6 大功效节点原文字、店铺会员角标与二维码、规格表原文字段与数值、持妆时长与刷毛/纤维倍率等数值断言，均改为 {callout_N}/{selling_point_N} 占位或 proof placeholder；独特弧形撕纸排版与曲线连接线只保留 thin-line 图标与圆窗的结构思路。主体商品一律以 {product} 占位，可换任一同类睫毛膏参考图复用。
